chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Mansur from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about the saying of Allah, Exalted is He: 'Stand [in prayer] by night, but not except a small amount.' He said: 'Allah commanded him to pray every night, unless a night from the nights comes upon him in which he does not pray anything.'

key_terms.لَا يُصَلِّي فِيهَا شَيْئًا: He does not pray anything in it

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'except a small amount' in the verse Qum al-layl illa qaleela?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the command 'Qum al-layla illa qaleela' mandates nightly night prayer (Tahajjud), with the exception being nights when the Prophet was entirely occupied or unable to pray. This interpretation highlights the flexibility within the obligation, distinguishing between a complete exemption and the general practice of consistent nocturnal worship, a key point in Shia jurisprudence regarding the Sunnah of the Prophet.
